title: Define deterministic Git branch scope identities
description: Implement the branch-scope primitive used by merge-safe task IDs. For every named Git branch, derive branchId as the first 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters (32 bits) of SHA-256 over the exact case-sensitive short branch name reported by runtime discovery. Detached HEAD and non-Git invocations must return no scope and remain legacy/global. Scope always comes from the actual invocation context; --git-branch metadata overrides must not affect it. Add fixed hash vectors plus named-branch, detached, and non-Git unit coverage. Keep this task limited to scope derivation and types; do not change flat-file allocation or claiming yet. This work intentionally follows wtp-0066 because the retained-handoff initiative overlaps the same codebase surfaces.
